_comment: Config for the footprint_audit tool — the per-BOARD validation pass that checks every placed symbol's Footprint assignment against the physical .kicad_mod, on a rendered .kicad_sch. This is the 'verify it's legal' half of the assign/validate split: pcb_gen + _resolve_default_footprint ASSIGN; footprint_audit VERIFIES. Complements check_pins.py (which validates the config maps statically) by validating the actual generated board. Read once and cached; RESTART the backend after edits. No Python literals per feedback_no_hardcode_json_config; verdict is words, never a % per feedback_no_percentage_scores.

rules._comment: One entry per checkable rule. enabled=false skips it. severity is one of error | warning | review | info and only affects how it's counted + the verdict; the tool never mutates the board.

explicit_package._rule: Rule 1 — every part must carry an EXPLICIT package identifier; the footprint must not be guessed from the symbol alone. Fires when the assignment's provenance is a guess tier (see provenance.guess_sources).

footprint_resolves._rule: The Lib:Footprint id must resolve to a real .kicad_mod on this machine (fp-lib-table + standard roots). An empty Footprint field also fails here.

pin_pad_match._rule: Rule 2 — every symbol pin NUMBER must exist as a footprint pad, and vice-versa. Mechanical pads (number '') and unnumbered symbol pins ('?','~') are ignored, matching check_pins.py.

tech_type._rule: Rule 5 — the footprint's pad technology (through-hole vs SMD) must match the intended assembly process (see assembly_process).

connector_review._rule: Rule 6 — connectors, switches and mechanical parts have no universal land pattern; flag each for human dimensional review against the datasheet.

polarity_pin1._rule: Rule 7 — polarized / keyed parts (diode, LED, electrolytic cap, transistor, IC) must have a pad '1' the symbol's pin 1 can key to. Warns when a flagged part's footprint has no pad '1'.

courtyard._rule: Rule 8a — every footprint must carry courtyard geometry (F.CrtYd / B.CrtYd) for downstream DFM + collision checks.

model_3d._rule: Rule 8b — warn (info) when a footprint has no (model ...) 3D reference. Info-only: a missing STEP never blocks a board.

provenance._comment: How _resolve_default_footprint_traced chose the footprint. trusted = a deliberate, reproducible decision; guess = inferred from family prefix or the symbol's own default, which Rule 1 warns against. An explicit Footprint in the architect IR always counts as 'explicit_ir' (most trusted).

assembly_process._comment: Expected board assembly tech. 'mixed' accepts both THT and SMD parts (default — most Envil prototype boards mix them). 'smt' flags any through-hole part; 'tht' flags any SMD part. Override per project by editing this value.

mechanical_refdes_prefixes._comment: Rule 6 — DYNAMIC triage (Appendix A). A part is connector/mechanical by its REFERENCE-designator prefix, derived per-part at runtime from the actual refdes — not a per-circuit list. The alpha prefix of the ref (J1->J, MH2->MH) is looked up here; the category is shown in the finding. This is the primary signal; review_classes below is only a generic lib_id fallback.

polarity_signals._comment: Rule 7 — DYNAMIC. A part needs pin-1 / polarity keying if, derived from the SYMBOL's own pins at runtime: (a) any pin carries a polarity-marker NAME, or (b) it has >= min_pins (so pin-1 orientation matters), or (c) its pins have asymmetric electrical types. lib_class_hints is a generic part-class fallback ONLY for polarized parts whose symbol leaves pins unnamed (e.g. C_Polarized). No per-circuit data anywhere.

review_classes._comment: Rule 6 FALLBACK only (generic part-class, not per-circuit). Used when the refdes prefix above doesn't classify the part. Lower-cased substrings tested against lib_id.

skip_ref_prefixes._comment: Reference prefixes that are virtual (power ports, PWR_FLAG, no-connects) and carry no footprint — never audited.

verdict.clean: FOOTPRINTS VERIFIED — {n} parts audited, all checks passed
verdict.review_only: FOOTPRINTS OK — {n} parts, {r} need human review (connectors/mechanical)
verdict.issues: FOOTPRINTS NOT CLEAN — {e} error(s), {w} warning(s), {r} review across {n} parts
verdict.no_parts: NO PARTS — schematic has no components to audit
